topic: Practical's on documentation based on following maintenance evolutions: (a) A defect observed in any system during flying or on ground (b) Any limitation and husbandry defects (c) Any defect cleared by DI/DR (d) Any defect cleared by robbing action (e) Any defect cleared by replacement of component and forecasting its life f) Entries made for ground Run / CTF / MTF g) Acceptance of A/C by pilot for Ground run, CTF & MTF h) Documentation linked to independent checks, supervisory checks and checks on special occasions.
syllabus_extract: Practical’s on documentation based on following maintenance evolutions: (a) A defect observed in any system during flying or on ground (b) Any limitation and husbandry defects (c) Any defect cleared by DI/DR (d) Any defect cleared by robbing action (e) Any defect cleared by replacement of component and forecasting its life f) Entries made for ground Run / CTF / MTF g) Acceptance of A/C by pilot for Ground run, CTF & MTF h) Documentation linked to independent checks, supervisory checks and checks on special occasions.
specific_objectives: 29.1.1.6 Trainee will be able to explain the documentation based on maintenance evolutions.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Documentation of maintenance evolutions including defect reporting, limitation entries, clearance actions, and pilot acceptance forms.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of maintenance documentation?
List three types of defects recorded in the logbook.
Who is responsible for signing off a defect clearance?

development.content:
Defect observation during flying
Defect observation on ground
Limitation and husbandry defects
Defect cleared by DI/DR
Defect cleared by robbing action

Defect cleared by replacement
Forecasting component life
Ground Run / CTF / MTF entries
Pilot acceptance documentation
Independent and supervisory checks

Documentation for special occasions
Review of completed entries
Error identification and correction
Final verification of records
Handover of documentation

summary_questions: Explain the difference between a DI/DR clearance and a robbing action clearance.
Describe the required steps for forecasting the life of a replaced component.
What specific documentation is required for pilot acceptance of an aircraft for a CTF?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a mock logbook entry sequence for a defect observed during flight, cleared by replacement, and accepted by the pilot for a Ground Run, referencing LP 02 procedures.
